source_title: Symmetrized Summation Polynomials: Using Small Order Torsion Points to Speed up Elliptic Curve Index Calculus

review_provenance.method: Independent review packet followed by direct primary-source confirmation.
review_provenance.boundary: The record binds claim locations and paraphrases. It is not a proof of novelty or of the paper's heuristic complexity assumptions.

claims.paraphrase: The paper constructs summation-polynomial symmetries from translation by rational small-order torsion. Coordinate translations whose torsion coefficients sum to zero preserve the point-decomposition relation, so the relation-preserving action can grow with the number of variables.
claims.boundary: The construction requires suitable rational torsion and equivariant morphisms; its direct applicability to secp256k1 is a separate target-property question.
